adaptation: Project-authored procedural summaries, not a claim that an upstream agent or vision model was executed.

skill_sources.name: scipilot-figure-skill
skill_sources.role: profile data before choosing charts; retain observations; group-size-aware distribution displays

skill_sources.name: bio-metagenomics-visualization
skill_sources.role: profiler-specific units, compositional scope, full-matrix diversity, no unsupported phylogenetic or differential claims

skill_sources.name: scientific-visualization
skill_sources.role: explicit transformations, final dimensions, redundant colors, captions and source data

guidance: Inspect sample count, quantitative units, missingness, group sizes and nonzero feature counts before choosing a recipe.
One or two samples do not support group distributions or significance claims. Never use taxa or genes as biological replicates.
Retain individual observations with box or violin summaries. Density is a visualization estimate, not additional observations.
Diversity and distances use the full validated feature matrix, never a displayed Top-N plus Other matrix.
Functional community profiles describe potential, not expression, activity, or species attribution.
Raw HUMAnN scores are not automatically comparable absolute cross-sample measurements. Within-named-feature fractions have an explicit denominator and do not estimate absolute load.
No hypothesis tests, P values, confidence ellipses, differential abundance, correlation networks or phylogenetic distances are generated by these recipes.
Missing/unquantifiable samples are not measured zero. No named pathways means skip the pathway plot, not invent features.
Use reproducible local numeric renderers. A text-only model proposes chart IDs, not executable code or numeric results.

prevalence_abundance.purpose: observed detection frequency and mean relative abundance, not a core-microbiome claim

feature_dot.purpose: named function composition or distinct pathway coverage

functional_clustered_heatmap.purpose: descriptive clustering of compatible named functions
